BETWEEN:-
 OMKAR SINGH S/O SHRI MOOLCHAND SINGH, AGED  ABOUT 20 YEARS, OCCUPATION: AGRICULTURE R/O  VILLAGE KHURSI POLICE STATION RAJENDRAGRAM  DISTRICT ANUPPUR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI SANJEEV KUMAR SINGH-ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION RAJENDRAGRAM DISTRICT ANUPPUR  (MADHYA PRADESH)

 (BY SMT. PAPIYA GHOSH-PANEL LAWYER FOR RESPONDENT/STATE  AND NONE FOR VICTIM DESPITE SERVICE OF NOTICE)

This application coming on for admission this day, the co  following:
 ORDER

This second bail application has been filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail in relation to FIR No.189/2023 dated 22.06.2023 registered at P.S.- Rajendragram, District - Anuppur (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376(1), 323, 506 of IPC and Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act, 2012.
He is in detention since 17.12.2023.

2. Applicant's first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed with liberty to renew the prayer for grant of bail after prosecutrix evidence before the trial Court vide order dated 01.02.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No.2115/2024.
3.
As per the prosecution story, on 22.06.2023, 17 years and 11 months old prosecutrix submitted an application in writing stating that she knew Omkar Singh who is brother-in-law of her elder sister.

sentences.text: On 09.03.2023 when at around 06:00 p.m. she had gone to answer call of nature, Omkar took her towards agricultural field side and committed rape upon her on the false promise of marriage.
Again on 20.06.2023, he repeated the same act on the false promise of marriage.
When she refused to go along with him, he voluntarily caused hurt and threatened that if she refused to enter into wedlock with him he will kill her.
FIR was registered.
After investigation, charge sheet has been filed.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
He was having love relations with the prosecutrix.
Prosecutrix was a consenting party and was on the verge of attaining the age of majority.
They had consensually established physical relations with each other.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.
6. In this case, prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial Court.
She has not supported prosecution story in toto.
Now there is no possibility of influencing of the prosecution witnesses and tempering with the prosecution evidence.
Therefore, having taken into consideration all facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, this second bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant - Omkar Singh be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
8 .
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
